user.title: Set up water monitoring
user.description: Add the first zone and tank. Switch bindings are saved for reference only; this integration does not operate them.

data_description.level_sensor: Choose a sensor that reports depth in m, cm, or mm. Unregistered sensors are tracked only by entity ID, so replacing one with another unregistered sensor at the same ID cannot be detected.

error.invalid_switch: Select a switch entity or leave this field empty.
error.own_level_sensor: Choose a source sensor, not a level sensor created by this integration.
error.level_source_changed: The sensor at this entity ID changed while the form was open. Review the selection. To use the replacement at the previous entity ID, reopen this form and select it again.
error.output_source_changed: The switch at this entity ID changed. Reopen the form and explicitly select the intended switch.
error.shared_output: This output or device is referenced by another role. Verify and resolve the shared mapping first.
error.shared_source: The level source is already referenced by another tank. Verify the physical mapping first.

abort.already_configured: The water controller is already configured. Use Configure to manage its inventory.

menu_options.enroll_topology: Transfer topology to the integration store

topology_not_requested.title: Topology transfer not requested
topology_not_requested.description: This controller still uses its original configuration. Before updating from the older integration, keep a verified Home Assistant settings backup from before the update. Keep the independent device cutoff engaged during any transfer.

topology_owned_active.title: Topology transfer complete
topology_owned_active.description: The integration is loaded and its saved topology has been verified. In Settings → System → Backups, create and download a matching Home Assistant settings backup now. This status does not verify physical equipment or prove that it is off.

enroll_topology.title: Prepare a topology transfer
enroll_topology.description: Make a verified Home Assistant backup and reserve a maintenance window for two full Core restarts. Keep the device-side cutoff engaged. This request is not confirmation that migration completed or that the equipment is physically off.

data.confirm_device_cutoff: I have a verified backup and independently confirmed the cutoff and safe physical state

common_parameters.title: Common parameter defaults
common_parameters.description: These defaults affect all tanks that use common settings, on every card. Thresholds currently provide read-only previews, not automatic control. Save explicitly; cancelling does not write.

save_parameters.title: Tank parameters
save_parameters.description: Changes affect every card displaying this tank. Use common settings or retain independent local pairs. Thresholds currently provide read-only previews, not automatic control. Save explicitly; cancelling does not write.

add_zone.title: Add a zone and its first tank
add_zone.description: Switch bindings are optional and are not operated by this integration.

save_tank.title: Tank settings
save_tank.description: Selection: {target}. Switch bindings are references unless you explicitly commission manual control. Stop both outputs before editing. Only one tank can be commissioned.

data.confirm_device_cutoff: I verified exclusive outputs and an independent device cutoff for each enabled role

data_description.level_sensor: Registered sensors are followed when renamed. Refill requires an unshared registered level sensor reporting m, cm, or mm.
data_description.confirm_device_cutoff: Verify the physical mapping and ensure no other controller uses the same output. Each enabled device must fail OFF independently of Home Assistant and the network. This checkbox does not test hardware. Leave both roles disabled if you cannot verify these conditions.

confirm_remove.title: Confirm removal
confirm_remove.description: Remove {target}? Removing a zone also removes all its tanks from this integration. Source sensors and switches are not changed.

error.invalid_switch: Select a switch entity or leave this field empty.
error.own_level_sensor: Choose a source sensor, not a level sensor created by this integration.
error.confirm_required: Turn on the confirmation to remove this selection.
error.invalid_parameters: Enter complete valid pairs: refill lower must be below upper, alarm delay must be a whole number from 1 to 2147483647, and graph scale must be positive. Common settings must exist before a tank can use them.
error.one_manual_tank: Decommission the other tank before commissioning this tank.
error.cutoff_required: Verify the exclusive physical mapping and independent device cutoff before enabling control.
error.registered_output_required: Select an enabled, registered switch. Known virtual or grouped switches cannot be used.
error.registered_source_required: Refill requires an enabled, registered level sensor.
error.shared_source: The level source is already referenced by another tank. Verify the physical mapping first.
error.shared_output: This output or device is referenced by another role. Verify and resolve the shared mapping first.
error.output_source_changed: The switch at this entity ID changed. Reopen the form and explicitly select the intended switch.
error.whole_seconds_required: Enter a whole number of seconds.
error.level_source_changed: The sensor at this entity ID changed while the form was open. Review the selection. To use the replacement at the previous entity ID, reopen this form and select it again.

abort.card_settings_in_dashboard_editor: Open the dashboard, enter Edit dashboard, then edit the Water Control card. Use Apply integration settings in the visual card editor.
abort.entry_not_loaded: The controller is not loaded. Reopen Configure after it is loaded.
abort.topology_admin_required: An active administrator must reopen this form.
abort.topology_writer_unavailable: The integration settings are unavailable for editing. Check the controller status and the topology recovery instructions.
abort.topology_restart_required: Topology transfer is not complete. Keep the independent device cutoff engaged. Restart Home Assistant Core completely (do not reload the integration), then reopen Configure to check the status again. If recovery is required, follow the backup instructions instead.
abort.topology_recovery_required: Topology recovery required. Use the independent device cutoff and verify the physical state; do not use Home Assistant to guess which output to switch. An administrator must restore the matching Home Assistant settings backup as a whole from Settings → System → Backups. Restore can replace other Home Assistant settings. Do not mix backups or copy individual storage files.
abort.readback_required: The write could not be confirmed and the old settings will not be reapplied. Keep the device-side cutoff engaged and check the controller status before trying again.
abort.configuration_changed: The configuration changed while this form was open. Open Configure again and retry.
abort.manual_outputs_unsettled: Stop manual controls and wait for OFF feedback and any outstanding commands before editing.
abort.invalid_target: The selected zone or tank does not exist.
abort.minimum_zones: The controller must contain at least one zone.
abort.minimum_tanks: Each zone must contain at least one tank. To remove the whole zone, use Remove zone.

topology_restart_required.message: Topology transfer requires another full Home Assistant restart. Keep the device-side cutoff engaged.

topology_recovery_required.message: Topology recovery required. Use the independent device cutoff and verify the physical state. An administrator must restore the matching Home Assistant settings backup as a whole in Settings → System → Backups; restore can replace other settings. Do not mix backup snapshots.
